name: Taliándörögd (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over green with a white triangle at the fly whose point reaches the centre, charged in the hoist with the municipal arms of Taliándörögd: a crowned blue shield with a figure holding a mace, above a scroll inscribed TALIÁNDÖRÖGD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Taliándörögd arms with crown and scroll
